description.value:
You thrust your hand forward and release a wave of Force energy in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take 3d6 force damage and, if Large or smaller, be pushed 5 feet away; a successful save halves the damage and prevents the push. Unattended objects of Medium size or smaller in the area are pushed 5 feet regardless.

Casting this power with a force slot of 2nd level or higher increases the damage by 1d6 for each slot level beyond 1st, and adds 5 feet to the push distance for every 2 slot levels above 1st.
